Method of Attack: Targets banking credentials using lists of back-end payment and point-of-sale software, online banking software, and crypto-currency wallet managers
Collects infected computer information (computer name, user name, OS installation date and version, installed software) and sends to command-and-control server
Command-and-control server responds with malware payloads or 403 HTTP error code, can blacklist machines
Uses multi-layered encrypted binary format to complicate analysis
Injects code into infected user's browser to capture data from banking websites
Discoverer: Nicholas Griffin, senior security researcher at Forcepoint
Attack Vector: Microsoft Office macros (recommended to disable by default)
